questions.text: In a college, the students in Science and Commerce faculties were in the ratio of 9 : 7, respectively. If 9 more students joined the Science faculty and 6 students left the Commerce faculty, the ratio of students in the Science and Commerce faculties becomes 12 : 5, respectively. How many students were there in both faculties together initially? Ans A). 144 B). 80 C). 112 D). 48 Correct Answer: D

₹ Nitin sells two articles for 6,314 each with no profit, no loss in the entire transaction. If one article was sold at a gain of 75%, then the other article is sold at a loss of: Ans A). 29% B). 27% C). 32% D). 30% Correct Answer: D

A car travels from city A to city B covering a total distance of 360 km under the following conditions, first 100 km covered at a speed of 50 km/h, next 80 km is covered at a speed of 40 km/h, then the car stops for 30 minutes. After that it covers 90 km distance at a speed of 60 km/h and the remaining distance it covers at a speed of 75 km/h. What is the average speed of the car for the entire journey including stoppage time? Ans A). 50 km/h B). 58 km/h C). 56 km/h D). 53 km/h Correct Answer: A
The mean of 12 numbers is 18. If one number 30 is replaced by 6, find the new mean. Ans A). 18 B). 16 C). 17 D). 19 Correct Answer: B

What is the average sale of cars per day on Saturdays, if the first Saturday is on the 3rd of March and average sale of cars per day for the whole month is 193?
